title: Keto Slovakian Jerked Potatoes
description: A low-carb twist on traditional Slovakian cuisine, using jerked meat and potatoes, perfect for a keto diet.
instructions: Peel and chop the Slovakian potatoes into 1-inch cubes.
Season the jerked meat with salt and black pepper.
In a greased oven-safe pan, sear the jerked meat over medium-high heat until browned on both sides.
Add the chopped potatoes to the pan, stirring to coat with the jerked meat's juices.
Sprinkle the gratin evenly over the potatoes and jerked meat.
Transfer the pan to the preheated oven and bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the potatoes are tender.
Remove from the oven and let rest for a few minutes before serving.
